# Backup

**Parity grade: A** · SDK `aws-sdk-go-v2/service/backup@v1.69.1` · last audited 2026-10-12 (`b7c35baea`)

### Known gaps

- Restore still keeps the synthesized CreatedResourceArn for Aurora, DocumentDB, Neptune, Redshift, FSx and Storage Gateway recovery points: no resource engine is wired for them (resource_engines_compute.go wires EC2, EFS, RDS instances, CloudFormation stacks and Timestream tables). Storage Gateway has no emulator under services/; FSx file creation takes an unexported input type (services/fsx/file_systems.go:530); the cluster types need a snapshot-restore path that carries the master credentials, which the DocumentDB (services/docdb/db_clusters.go:85), Neptune (services/neptune/db_clusters.go:125) and Redshift (services/redshift/store.go:335) create paths do not offer.

### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- MPA session approval, GuardDuty malware scanning (PITR results, ScanActions/ScanSettings), the search-index subsystem and cross-account logically-air-gapped vaults are external systems with no emulator counterpart.
- CreatedBy on scan jobs and recovery points: plans never run on a schedule here, so every recovery point comes from an on-demand job with no plan or rule lineage (ByBackupPlanId likewise matches nothing).
- StartBackupJob CompleteWindowMinutes and StartRestoreJob CopySourceTagsToRestoredResource: backup jobs finish instantly (no window to expire) and restored resources do not copy source tags.
